(event Custom|UpdateSpeed (NewSpeed)
  (Widget|SetText(Text) (Variables|UI_Vehicle|GetSpeedLabel) (Utilities|Text|ToText(Float) (* (Math|Float|Absolute(Float) NewSpeed) (Math|Float|SelectFloat 0.022000 0.036000 (|GetbIsMPH))) "HalfToEven" false true 3 3 0 0)))

(event Custom|UpdateGear (NewGear)

    (:-1
      (Widget|SetText(Text) _gearlabel "NSLOCTEXT(\"[9E0E43924D09D3EEDC90159E87F88F10]\", \"D7B02B5B441B6E53AEC7329820AF997E\", \"R\")"))
